verdict.rationale: The Prompt Library docs mention tracking prompt versions with full diffs, which offers some review/versioning capability, but this covers prompts only, not the platform's routing/fallback/load-balancing 'automations' (policies), and there is no evidence of a rollback mechanism for any automation logic. Missing for 10: version history and rollback for routing/fallback/load-balancing policies, an explicit rollback UI/API, and any review workflow beyond prompt diffs.
